# `aitbc transactions search`

Search transactions by address, sender, or recipient.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc transactions search [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | no | Blockchain address on either side of the transaction. |
| `--sender` | text | — | no | Return only transactions sent by this address. |
| `--recipient` | text | — | no | Return only transactions received by this address. |
| `--limit` | integer | `100` | no | Number of transactions to return |
| `--use-explorer` | flag | `false` | no | Use Explorer API instead of RPC |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC base URL (overrides config) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc transactions search
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc transactions search --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
